title: Drum
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- drum shell -->
  <rect x='25' y='42' width='50' height='34' rx='4' fill='#d94a3a'/>
  <!-- shell lighter highlight -->
  <rect x='29' y='46' width='8' height='26' rx='3' fill='#f07a6a'/>
  <!-- zigzag tension lugs -->
  <rect x='25' y='56' width='50' height='4' fill='#b83428'/>
  <!-- top drumhead -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='25' ry='10' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <!-- drumhead inner shading -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='18' ry='7' fill='#e8d4a8'/>
  <!-- rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='25' ry='10' fill='none' stroke='#e0b84a' stroke-width='4'/>
  <!-- bottom rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='25' ry='10' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='25' ry='10' fill='none' stroke='#e0b84a' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- drum shell front bottom fill -->
  <path d='M25 76 A25 10 0 0 0 75 76 L75 60 A25 10 0 0 1 25 60 Z' fill='#d94a3a'/>
  <!-- left stick -->
  <rect x='30' y='8' width='4' height='32' rx='2' fill='#c99a5b' transform='rotate(-18 32 24)'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='10' r='3' fill='#f0d090'/>
  <!-- right stick -->
  <rect x='66' y='8' width='4' height='32' rx='2' fill='#c99a5b' transform='rotate(18 68 24)'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='10' r='3' fill='#f0d090'/>
</svg>
